I wonder if the actual reference pattern isn't the square block itself but something involving just the scattered 2s, though each row seems to contain only a single 2, undermining that idea.

Perhaps each isolated 2 marks a translation vector for placing a copy of the pattern, giving me candidate shifts like (−1,+9), (3,9), (4,9), (4,0), and (5,0) to test by overlaying squares at each location.
